dedupe_keys.name: opendata opnv and delfi german public transport open data stops timetables real time

description: OpenData ÖPNV is an initiative of German mobility companies that gathers their published public transport data, which the portal says can be used freely: stop, timetable and real-time data through downloads and APIs. It hosts the nationwide DELFI datasets, including a central, maintained register of all stops in Germany and event and disruption information for public passenger transport, and it presents applications built on the data, such as reachability analyses from a chosen stop, departure monitors and event trip planners; a DELFI user day was planned for November 2026 in Gelsenkirchen. Coverage: Germany. Format and access: downloads and APIs, some needing a user account. Licence and cost: free; terms are set per partner dataset. Caveats: the site is in German, and formats and licences differ between partners. It supports network flow and emergency response studies of German transit, for instance with disruption feeds. It relates to the GTFS specification, the NeTEx and SIRI standards and the Dutch NDOV public transport data in the catalogue.
